options.label: Panel key
options.description:
Opens and closes the CameraPlus panel, where you set up the exploration, indoor, combat, zoom and idle cameras.

The game doesn't see this key. The default is F1.

options.label: Panel button
options.description:
Opens the CameraPlus panel with a controller.

While the panel is open, the D-pad chooses and changes, A selects, X sets the game's value, B closes and holding LB makes finer steps. The game doesn't see controller buttons then, but the sticks still move and look around.

During play the game doesn't see this button; in the pause menu and the map it's the game's. The default is D-pad Left.
